text:
Maya (CS): FYI SoundWave asked for a brief SG peering window + temporary throughput lift for a migration cutover. They want 3x token QPS for 24h and the peering CIDR added to SG proxy. Can we support?
Nora (SoundWave Ops): yes please. Cutover planned Mon 21:00-23:00 UTC. Traffic will originate from 34.101.0.0/16 and 35.240.0.0/14. Only HTTPS egress. Renewal conversation in 3 weeks — good cutover reduces upgrade friction.
Ethan (NetOps): I can add the CIDRs. Recommend auto-revoke at 48h to be safe. Want confirmation on exact ports/protocols — only 443?
Nora (SoundWave Ops): correct. 443 only.
Liu (Platform): for rate bump, prefer to create a tenant-scoped "migration_boost" policy rather than touching global limits. Suggest canary (5%) for first 10m then full for safety. Also can raise tenant KV cache to help with repeated context.
Omar (SE): agree. also flip on tokenization diagnostics for the window — they had odd p99 spikes during their last stress run.
Maya (CS): plan summary: (1) Ethan adds CIDRs to sg-proxy with auto-revoke 48h, (2) Liu schedules migration_boost policy with 3x multiplier starting Mon 21:00 UTC, canary 5% 10m, (3) Omar enables token diag + prefix cache bump, (4) Nora runs two synthetics and posts logs.
Ethan (NetOps): queued. I'll create rule and paste config. ETA 20m.
deploy-bot: egress-rule created: id=egress-sw-176543, cidrs=[34.101.0.0/16,35.240.0.0/14], ports=[443], region=ap-southeast-1, auto_revoke=172800s.
Omar (SE): quick note — request we also set a per-request token cap at 8k for the migration to limit runaway cost. SoundWave agreed.
Nora (SoundWave Ops): ok on 8k cap. We'll throttle at client side too.
Liu (Platform): creating migration policy now: name=sw-migration-176543, multiplier=3.0, phases=[canary:5%:10m,full:100%:rest], expires=2025-08-18T23:00:00Z. Applying flags to tenant only.
Maya (CS): can we also enable the realtime dashboard and a small alert: p95 > 400ms or 5xx rate > 0.5%? want to notify SE & CS.
Liu (Platform): yes I'll wire an alert to #oncall-ai and tag Omar + Maya.
Ethan (NetOps): egress changes applied and validated from our side. sample health curl from customer IP returns 200. snippet:
```
curl -H "Host: api.redwood.company" --resolve api.redwood.company:443:34.101.5.20 https://api.redwood.company/health
```
deploy-bot: rollout sw-migration-176543 created, state=scheduled, starts=2025-08-18T21:00:00Z.
Maya (CS): Nora please run these two tests during window and upload: (A) 256-token generation x100 (B) long-form 5k-token summarize x10. capture latency, errors, and token usage.
Nora (SoundWave Ops): will do. uploading to https://redwooddrive.company/onboarding/soundwave/migration.
Omar (SE): config snippet to enable prefix KV and token diag:
```
tenant: soundwave
features:
  prefix_kv_cache: true
  kv_ttl: 7200
  max_cached_prefix_tokens: 4096
  tokenization_logging: verbose
  per_request_token_cap: 8000
```
Liu (Platform): pushing flags now for their tenant only. Monitoring memory and will rollback if pressure > 80%.
deploy-bot: rollout sw-migration-176543 phase=canary started: 5% traffic -> ap-southeast-1.
Maya (CS): leaving renewal note: this migration success will be discussed in renewal review. Please collect exec metrics.
Nora (SoundWave Ops): can confirm canary looks good from our side. no errors so far.
Omar (SE): seeing p95 ~150ms during canary. token diag shows some tokenization stalls on certain long sequences; collecting logs.
Liu (Platform): canary healthy. promoting to full now.
deploy-bot: rollout sw-migration-176543 promoted to full.
Maya (CS): post-window reminders: - Nora upload synthetics (pending) - Omar prepare exec summary (latency, p95/p99, 5xx, cost delta, recommendations) - Liu share dashboards and any infra notes - Ethan confirm auto-revoke and cleanup.
Nora (SoundWave Ops): uploads complete. short findings: 256-token runs p95 120ms, 5k-token p95 420ms, no 5xx, cost delta +22% during window. full logs in drive.
Omar (SE): exec summary posted to thread. recommends moving to a sustained 1.5x throttle for next month while they evaluate Dedicated.
Liu (Platform): auto-revoke executed; egress sw-176543 revoked after 48h. cache flags rolled back to baseline.
Ethan (NetOps): confirming cleanup done.
Maya (CS): awesome — customer happy, migration smooth. marking as positive renewal indicator and closing thread. Thanks all! :party_popper:
